2026 to 2027. 401(k)/403(b)/TSP elective deferral: $24,500 to not published. IRA limit: $7,500 to not published. HSA self-only: $4,400 to $4,500 (+$100). HSA family: $8,750 to $9,000 (+$250). Social Security wage base: $184,500 to $192,300 (+$7,800). 2027 plan and IRA limits are not published yet.

This is general information, not tax or financial advice. Your plan document may allow less (for example no age 60-63 catch-up). Check with your plan administrator or a tax professional.

structuredContent.not_published: The IRS has not announced the 2027 401(k), 403(b), 457, IRA, SIMPLE, 415(c), compensation or HCE limits. On 2026-11-02 the IRS news release list ran through IR-2026-129 (Oct. 29, 2026) with no cost-of-living notice for 2027 (the 2026 notice, IR-2025-111 / Notice 2025-67, came out in November 2025). This server does not guess or forecast. Use 2026 as the latest published year.
